name: Neko Para vol.4 ~Neko to Patissier no Noel~
original_name: ネコぱらvol.4～ネコとパティシエのノエル～
source:
Despite the popularity of Kashou Minaduki's patisserie, "La Soleil", his father continues to disapprove of it.

Seeing how troubled Kashou was, Shigure offers up a suggestion as a change of pace.
A hot springs trip with Chocola, Vanilla and the other catpanions.
With Azuki and Coconut's encouragement, Kashou is determined to confront his father while Maple and Cinnamon suggest a trip to France to seek advice from the teacher who taught him his craft.

But why is Shigure also tagging along!?

And an encounter with a new catgirl in France...

This story is a heartwarming cat comedy about the growth Kashou experiences through his catpanions and the bonds with them and his family...

[From [url=https://denpasoft.com/blogs/news/kurocon-2020-updates-announcements]Denpasoft[/url]]
translation:
水无月嘉祥经营的西点店“La Soleil”虽然广受欢迎，却始终得不到父亲的认可。

看着嘉祥烦恼的样子，时雨提议换个心情。
于是，大家与巧克力、香草等猫娘一同踏上温泉之旅。
在红豆和椰子的鼓励下，嘉祥下定决心，再次直面父亲。而枫与桂则建议他前往法国，向当初传授自己手艺的师傅寻求指点。

可是，为什么连时雨也跟来了？！

还有，在法国与新猫娘的邂逅…

这是一部温馨的猫娘喜剧，讲述嘉祥在与猫娘相处中获得的成长，以及他与猫娘、家人之间的羁绊…

[摘自[url=https://denpasoft.com/blogs/news/kurocon-2020-updates-announcements]Denpasoft[/url]]
